messages.content: "請問你能幫我提供一些資訊嗎？首先，我想知道在晚餐時從'AllRecipes'網站上的'Chicken Alfredo'食譜中所含的卡路里量。其次，我對'Apple'、'Microsoft'和'Tesla'的最新股價有興趣。最後，我想知道2018年巴西男子足球隊的FIFA排名。"

function.name: get_stock_price
function.description: Retrieves the current stock price of the specified companies Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

company_names.description: The list of companies for which to retrieve the stock price.

function.name: get_team_ranking
function.description: Retrieve the FIFA ranking of a specific soccer team for a certain year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the soccer team.

year.description: The year for which the ranking is to be retrieved.

gender.description: The gender of the team. It can be either 'men' or 'women'. Default is 'men'.

function.name: recipe_info_get_calories
function.description: Retrieve the amount of calories from a specific recipe in a food website. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

website.description: The food website that has the recipe.

optional_meal_time.description: Specific meal time of the day for the recipe (optional, could be 'Breakfast', 'Lunch', 'Dinner'). Default is 'Dinner'
